_comment: #350: the leased room behind inn_upstairs' hallway_door_a (gated on room_purchased). Walk-in only, no portals row; biome, sprites and floor swatch all reused. Perimeter is walls.segments with a gap at (4,6) for the exit door, so wall cells are never also in `blocked`; `blocked` is empty because nothing here reads solid.
_comment_mood: NO data/moods.json row yet (that file is the moods lane's this wave), so the grade is identity white at EVERY phase and no gate can catch it -- the row to add is queued verbatim in .lane-progress SEAM 1. player_room_loop's 07_room_night shot is the standing eye-check.
interior_flavor: Nothing there — just your own four walls, and the particular quiet of a room nobody else is paying for.

floor_layers._pick: The pale swept board [16,21]/[17,21] the inn's own upstairs uses for its bedroom corner, so the room you bought is floored like the corner that was already yours. Same sheet, same licence, same wood footsteps.
One warmer plank band under the bed wall, from the inn's hall swatch, so the room is not one flat tone edge to edge.

entities.observe: The hall on the other side, and this door swings in when you pull it.

entities._comment: Second sleep site. `your_bed` upstairs is NOT moved or gated: a player who never leases keeps the free bed. Ladder rungs ascend, highest satisfied wins.

sleep_toast.text: Your own room, and a door you can shut behind you.
Your own room, and bedding that goes out to the line and comes back turned down.
Your own room, the best bedding in the house, and a shut door between you and all of Liscor.

entities.observe: Made up tight, corners squared. Lyonette did that, and she will know if you undo it badly.

entities.locked_toast: Your own footlocker, empty. Bare boards inside, and one dry hinge.
entities.observe: A plain footlocker at the head of the bed, hasp and no lock. Everything you own would rattle around in it.

entities.locked_toast: The desk is yours to use. Nothing on it yet is asking to be done.
entities.observe: A narrow desk under the window, one drawer, and a pale ring where somebody set a cup down for a whole winter.

entities.locked_toast: Nothing on the shelves yet. Give it a season.
entities.observe: Three shelves and you have filled none of them. The lowest board is loose and slides.

entities.locked_toast: You hang the day's coat on a peg.
entities.observe: A row of pegs, the paint worn off at shoulder height.
